scope: C1-AB static source audit, not runtime or performance acceptance
adaptations: Extract existing packed activation, Unary shell, RMSNorm warp/CTA/double-load device kernels and norm/tile helpers; omit TVM/Python host wrappers and Blackwell-only 32-byte variant.
Isolate namespace as hyle::compute::cuda_native::sglang_vendor and SGL_DEVICE as HYLE_SGL_DEVICE.
Packed gate arithmetic is unchanged. Unary uses HYLE ordinary stable-tail/-Inf contract: erfc GELU, stable sigmoid SiLU/GELU-tanh; math adaptation is explicit.
RMSNorm arithmetic, indexing, vector grouping and reduction order retained. HYLE private shim supplies CUDA scalar/packed types, RNE casts, pointer offsets, float warp shuffle sum and disabled PDL.
RMSNorm host binding preserves upstream shape selection and pre-Blackwell launch policy; occupancy/SM count are bound once during preparation; no runtime search.
remaining: LayerNorm and other C1 CUDA mature coverage
